'''Elvis''' was a [[Unidentified hairless dog-like creature|dog-like]] [[Alien|creature]] that could be found on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] during [[3 BBY]].<ref name="Ever Been To Ghorman?" /> They wore a collar with their name inscribed in it in the [[Dixian]] script of the [[Ghor (language)|Ghor]] [[language]].<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-2|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 2 Trivia}}</ref>

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Dixian.jpg|thumb|Elvis's collar with the inscription of its name, written in Dixian]]
Elvis made their debut in the [[Ever Been to Ghorman?|fourth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Ever Been To Ghorman?" /> directed by [[Ariel Kleiman]] and aired on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> For Andor Season 2, the production crew rushed to create Elvis, with meching done by both [[Matt Hart]] who did the head and [[Ashton McCarthy-Gardner]] who did the body, as well as additional assistance by [[Cerina Knott]] who helped them make their deadline. They were puppeteered by both [[Wim Oppenheimer]] and [[Neil Sterenberg]].<ref name="Puppeteer">{{Instagram|username=matt.hart87|url=p/DJpk-MctJ4c|name=[[Matt Hart]]|date=2025-05-14|quote=Well, the wait was worth it, what a great show and a pleasure to work on.
I feel like the majority of my work on this was on set, but managed to build a few heads too, which all appeared! I even got my first puppeteer credit for the Cyclops I built!! (Despite also puppeteering a senator earlier in the series...) In 2023, I also had a great trip with the CFX team to Valencia to shoot a load of great content at the impressive Museo de las Ciencias Príncipe Felipe. 1. Cyclops - I meched and puppeteered, performed by the amazing @cavincornwall 2. Boris - I meched and was performed by the amazing @lauren97king and puppeteered on set by the equally amazing @claireroiharvey. This guy should have had more screen time! 3. 'Elvis' the dog - I meched the head and @ashflash_26 meched the body, was a rushed build and looked great when we finished it. Shout-out to @cerinaknott for the late night we all did to get it over the line. Performed by the brilliant @wimoppenheimer and @neilsterenbergpuppeteer On to the next job with a bunch of incredible people 🤘|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/qKe9G}}</ref>
